title: Kon Tum in a day
summary: The timber church on Nguyen Hue in the morning, then the prison museum in the centre. Add Kon Klor and Kon K’Tu if you have a motorbike or a taxi for the five kilometres across the bridge.

stops.name: Wooden church
stops.note: Nguyen Hue timber, stained glass, and the Ba Na roofline. Sunday Mass is 6:00, 8:00, and 17:00 on Go Vietnam.

stops.name: Kon Tum Prison
stops.note: Go Vietnam prints 30,000 VND. The provincial portal does not print that fee. Confirm it at the gate.
